regions.merged_text: . .. Many thanks for your kind favor just noted-including Miss Riss" request. .Of course I sympathize with you .... that peculiarity you complain of but you have to be patient .... you could-and I believe you'd improve if you were to promise St. Francis you'd join the Third Order if he would obtain for you the grace to overcome the difficulty. In the mean time pray on and have patience-with Muriel especially-remembering that Charity rightly ordered always begins at home. Now God bless you again and thanks for the stamps. Please sigh a little prayer for removal of my old defects .... stupidity etc too.
